title: Starlight Pet Protection
description: A pet protection plugin that allows pets to respawn after death - vanilla consequences without permanent loss!
body: A pet protection plugin created for my server, Starlight Supernova. Rather than making pets invulnerable and op in some situations, this plugin allows pets (any tamed entity) to respawn one Minecraft day after death. By default they will respawn at the player's spawn position, but a spot can be assigned for them with /setpetspawn. This allows the consequences for throwing dogs into a fight they can't win or leaping a horse off a cliff without losing the pet permanently.
